hook: Chest pain on a fishing boat, 80 miles out.
narration: This boat was churning through white water, eighty miles off San Diego.
One man aboard the sport fishing boat Eclipse was having chest pain.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Sector San Diego flew out and lowered its rescue swimmer toward the moving deck.
The boat keeps its course into the wind, so the pilots can hold a steady hover beside it while the hoist works.
Then the litter came back up, swinging over the white water.
outcome: And the aircrew flew the man to Sector San Diego and handed him to emergency medical crews.

location_card.place: 80 miles southwest of San Diego, California

title: Chest pain 80 miles off San Diego
description:
On Sept. 14, 2012, a Coast Guard Sector San Diego aircrew hoisted a 35-year-old man with chest pain off the sport fishing vessel Eclipse, 80 miles southwest of San Diego, and turned him over to emergency medical personnel.
